plain_english: To the many-formed, whose nature is consciousness — fire, moon, sun, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, moving and unmoving — bow.
sanskrit_cite: agnīṣomaravibrahmaviṣṇusthāvarajaṅgama | svarūpa bahurūpāya namaḥ saṃvinmayāya te

plain_english: To the great fire fed by the universe as fuel, smeared-pure with great ash, to the Becoming to whom the world is the sole oblation — bow.
sanskrit_cite: viśvendhanamahākṣārānulepaśucivarcase | mahānalāya bhavate viśvaikahaviṣe namaḥ

plain_english: To Śiva-fire — cool, dense with supreme nectar — and to You, the unequalled devourer in the world's destruction — bow.
sanskrit_cite: paramāmṛtasāndrāya śītalāya śivāgnaye | kasmai cid viśvasaṃploṣaviṣamāya namo 'stu te

plain_english: To Mahādeva, to Rudra, to Śaṅkara, to Śiva, to You Maheśvara — and to someone mantra-bodied — bow.
sanskrit_cite: mahādevāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te | maheśvarāyāpi namaḥ kasmai cin mantramūrtaye

plain_english: To Śiva-fire — cut, dried up, the three worlds' melted fat the oblation — unequalled, yet auspicious — bow.
sanskrit_cite: namo nikṛttaniḥśoṣatrailokyavigaladvasā- | vasekaviṣamāyāpi maṅgalāya śivāgnaye

plain_english: To the god — to gracious someone — for whom the meeting of all marks is itself the mark — bow.
sanskrit_cite: samastalakṣanāyoga eva yasyopalakṣaṇam | tasmai namo 'stu devāya kasmai cid api śambhave

plain_english: To the hidden Lord — Veda-opposing, Veda-making, the Veda's true essence, secret master — bow.
sanskrit_cite: vedāgamaviruddhāya vedāgamavidhāyine | vedāgamasatattvāya guhyāya svāmine namaḥ

plain_english: Sole cause of the wheel of births and deaths — and its sole opponent; saṃsāra-formed, saṃsāra-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
sanskrit_cite: saṃsāraikanimittāya saṃsāraikavirodhine | namaḥ samsārarūpāya niḥsaṃsārāya śambhave

plain_english: To root, to middle, to tip; embodied as root-middle-tip; with tip-middle-root exhausted — to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
sanskrit_cite: mūlāya madhyāyāgrāya mūlamadhyāgramūrtaye | kṣīnāgramadhyamūlāya namaḥ pūrṇāya śambhave

plain_english: Even once — whosever taking of the Name — ripened heaps of merit. To You, Śiva, hard to attain — bow.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sukṛtasaṃbharavipākaḥ sakṛd apy asau | yasya nāmagrahas tasmai durlabhāya śivāya te

plain_english: To You alone — consciousness-formed, skull-bearing — ever sporting with heaped multitudes of moving-and-static forms — bow.
sanskrit_cite: namaścarācarākāraparetanicayaiḥ sadā | krīḍate tubhyam ekasmai cinmayāya kapāline

plain_english: To the magician, the pure, the hidden, the self-manifest; the subtle, the all-formed — to wondrous Śambhu — bow.
sanskrit_cite: māyāvine viśuddhāya guhyāya prakaṭātmane | sūkṣmāya viśvarūpāya namaś citrāya śambhave

plain_english: To all power — whose play destroys the Brahmā-Viṣṇu-arrayed world — wonder-working — bow.
sanskrit_cite: brahmendraviṣṇunirvyūḍhajagatsaṃhārakelaye | āścaryakaraṇīyāya namas te sarvaśaktaye

plain_english: To You, the fathomless Hara-ocean — whose powers are gained by those wandering only its shores — bow.
sanskrit_cite: taṭeṣv eva paribhrāntaiḥ labdhās tās tā vibhūtayaḥ | yasya tasmai namas tubhyam agādhaharasindhave

plain_english: To the lovely hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus, dwelling mid mud of the Māyā-made dense world, unsmeared, shining — bow.
sanskrit_cite: māyāmayajagatsāndrapaṅkamadhyādhivāsine | alepāya namaḥ śambhuśatapatrāya śobhine

plain_english: Auspicious, pure, treasure, self-ornamented; dear, ultimate-real, highest — to You — bow.
sanskrit_cite: maṅgalāya pavitrāya nidhaye bhūṣaṇātmane | priyāya paramārthāya sarvotkṛṣṭāya te namaḥ

plain_english: Ever bound, ever sharing liberation's portion; difference-free — to gracious someone Śambhu — bow.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ satatabaddhāya nityanirmuktibhāgine | bandhamokṣavihīnāya kasmai ci d api śambhave

plain_english: In these three worlds whose essence is mockery alone — to You alone, secondless, ever-bliss-seated — bow.
sanskrit_cite: upahāsaikasāre 'sminn etāvati jagattraye | tubhyam evādvitīyāya namo nityasukhāsine

plain_english: Essence of right-observance yet desirer of left-observance; of all observances, to observance-free Śarva — bow.
sanskrit_cite: dakṣiṇācārasārāya vāmācārābhilāṣiṇe | sarvācārāya śarvāya nirācārāya te namaḥ

plain_english: Whoever is worshipped, however, wherever — and whoever, whatever god he be — to that god, bow.
sanskrit_cite: yathā tathāpi yaḥ pūjyo yatra tatrāpi yo 'rcitaḥ | yo 'pi vā so 'pi vā yo 'sau devas tasmai namo 'stu te

plain_english: Served by liberation-seekers, remover of all burning; of spread-out chosen loveliness — to You, boon-giver — bow.
sanskrit_cite: mumukṣujanasevyāya sarvasantāpahāriṇe | namo vitatalāvaṇyavarāya varadāya te

plain_english: To You, Lord of the ever-festival, whose three worlds brim with unbroken bliss-rasa — bow.
sanskrit_cite: sadā nirantarānandarasanirbharitākhila- | trilokāya namas tubhyaṃ svāmine nityaparvaṇe

plain_english: Whatever enjoys You through pleasure-first knowables — to that terrible host of Your powers — bow.
sanskrit_cite: sukhapradhānasaṃvedyasambhogair bhajate ca yat | tvām eva tasmai ghorāya śaktivṛndāya te namaḥ

plain_english: Even sages cannot know Him — yet those whose gestures love connects embrace Him. To that someone Becoming — bow.
sanskrit_cite: munīnām apy avijñeyaṃ bhaktisambandhaceṣṭitāḥ | āliṅganty api yaṃ tasmai kasmai cid bhavate namaḥ

plain_english: To the supreme-nectar sheath, the supreme-nectar heap; reachable beyond far and near — to Becoming — bow.
sanskrit_cite: paramāmṛtakośāya paramāmṛtarāśaye | sarvapāramyapāramyaprāpyāya bhavate namaḥ

plain_english: I praise Your mantra-formed, clear-cool, unprecedentedly joyful, supreme-nectar-juicy form.
sanskrit_cite: mahāmantramayaṃ naumi rūpaṃ te svacchaśītalam | apūrvamodasubhagaṃ parāmṛtarasolvaṇam

plain_english: On oneness-fame's great cloth, full of immortality-nectar — where, Lord, there is no wonder — I praise Your teaching.
sanskrit_cite: svātantryāmṛtapūrṇatvad aikyakhyātimahāpaṭe | citraṃ nāsty eva yatreśa tan naumi tava śāsanam

plain_english: Thunderbolt to all doubt, world-end fire to all misfortune, world's-end to all joylessness — we bow the Māheśvara path.
sanskrit_cite: sarvāśaṅkāsaniṃ sarvālakṣmīkālānalaṃ tathā | sarvāmaṅgalyakalpāntaṃ mārgaṃ māheśvaraṃ numaḥ

plain_english: Victory, god! Bow upon bow to You; this whole world rests on You; of worlds You are supreme Lord; I am come to You for refuge, the One supreme.
sanskrit_cite: jaya deva namo namo 'stu te sakalaṃ viśvam idaṃ tavāśritam | jagatāṃ parameśvaro bhavān paramekaḥ śaraṇāgato 'smi te
